#Libraries
```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library(ROSE)
library(pROC)
library(rsample)
library(caret)
library(tree)
library(randomForest)
```


## Data Cleaning

```{r}
cardio_well <- read.csv("datasets/CardioWell.csv", stringsAsFactors = TRUE)

cardio_well %>% glimpse()

colSums(is.na(cardio_well)) # Sums up number of missing variables for each variable

cardio_well_clean <- 
  cardio_well %>% 
  drop_na(glucose, education, BPMeds, cigsPerDay, BMI, heartRate) %>% 
  mutate(TenYearCHD = factor(TenYearCHD),
         prevalentStroke = factor(prevalentStroke),
         prevalentHyp = factor(prevalentHyp),
         diabetes = factor(diabetes),
         BPMeds = factor(BPMeds)) %>% 
  select(-id)




colSums(is.na(cardio_well_clean))

cardio_well_clean %>% glimpse()

table(cardio_well_clean$TenYearCHD)

```


## Modeling Processs

Pre: Train Test Split of 75/25

```{r}

set.seed(310)
cardio_split <- initial_split(cardio_well_clean, prop= 0.75)
cardio_train <- training(cardio_split)
cardio_test <- testing(cardio_split)
```

1) Baseline Model (simple tree based model)

```{r}
# First Tree Model with all variables except education
cardio_tree <- tree(TenYearCHD ~ age + 
                      sex + 
                      is_smoking + 
                      cigsPerDay + 
                      BPMeds + 
                      prevalentStroke + 
                      prevalentHyp +
                      diabetes +
                      totChol+
                      diaBP+
                      sysBP+
                      BMI+
                      heartRate+
                      glucose,
                    data=cardio_train)

plot(cardio_tree)
text(cardio_tree, pretty = 0, cex=0.7)

print(cardio_tree)


pred_train <- predict(cardio_tree, newdata=cardio_train, type='class')
pred_test <- predict(cardio_tree, newdata=cardio_test, type='class')

pred_test %>% head()

table(pred_train, cardio_train$TenYearCHD) 
table(pred_test, cardio_test$TenYearCHD)
```

2) Second Model (bigger tree based model)
```{r}

cardio_tree_big <- tree(TenYearCHD ~ .,
                        data=cardio_train,
                        control = tree.control(nrow(cardio_train),
                                               mindev=0.005))

plot(cardio_tree_big)
text(cardio_tree_big, pretty = 0, cex=0.7)

summary(cardio_tree_big)

pred_train_big <- predict(cardio_tree_big, newdata=cardio_train, type='class')
pred_test_big <- predict(cardio_tree_big, newdata=cardio_test, type='class')


table(pred_train_big, cardio_train$TenYearCHD) 
table(pred_test_big, cardio_test$TenYearCHD)

```


3) Third Model (pruned tree from previous model)

```{r}

cardio_cv <- cv.tree(cardio_tree_big,
                     FUN = prune.misclass)

print(cardio_cv)

cv.results <- data.frame(
  size = cardio_cv$size,
  error = cardio_cv$dev
)

print(cv.results)

pruned_cardio_tree <- prune.misclass(cardio_tree_big, best=3)

plot(pruned_cardio_tree)
text(pruned_cardio_tree)

pred_train_prune <- predict(pruned_cardio_tree, newdata=cardio_train, type='class')
pred_test_prune <- predict(pruned_cardio_tree, newdata=cardio_test, type='class')

table(pred_train_prune, cardio_train$TenYearCHD) 
table(pred_test_prune, cardio_test$TenYearCHD)


```

4) ROSE Upsampling
```{r}
cardio_rose <-  ROSE(TenYearCHD ~ .,
                     data = cardio_well_clean,
                     N = 4000,
                     p = 0.4, 
                     seed = 1)$data

table(cardio_rose$TenYearCHD)

set.seed(310)
cardio_rose_split <- initial_split(cardio_rose, prop=0.75)
cardio_rose_train <- training(cardio_rose_split)
cardio_rose_test  <- testing(cardio_rose_split)

table(cardio_rose_train$TenYearCHD)
table(cardio_rose_test$TenYearCHD)
```


5) Fourth Model (Random Forest with Upsampled Data)

```{r}
rf_cardio <- randomForest(TenYearCHD ~ age+ 
                    sex + 
                    is_smoking + 
                    cigsPerDay + 
                    BPMeds + 
                    prevalentStroke + 
                    prevalentHyp +
                    diabetes +
                    totChol+
                    diaBP+
                    sysBP+
                    BMI+
                    heartRate+
                    glucose,
                  data=cardio_rose_train,
                  ntree = 50,
                  mtry = 3,
                  importance = TRUE)


plot(rf_cardio)       

pred_rf_cardio_train <- predict(rf_cardio, newdata = cardio_rose_train, type = 'class')
pred_rf_cardio_test <- predict(rf_cardio, newdata = cardio_rose_test, type = 'class')

table(pred_rf_cardio_train, cardio_rose_train$TenYearCHD)
table(pred_rf_cardio_test, cardio_rose_test$TenYearCHD)

```

6) Fifth Model (Adding Interactions and Polynomials)

```{r}
data_interactions_poly <- cardio_rose_train %>% 
  mutate(age_cigsPerDay = age * cigsPerDay,
         age_glucose = age * glucose,
         sysBPsquared = sysBP * sysBP)

data_test_interactions_poly <- cardio_rose_test %>% 
  mutate(age_cigsPerDay = age * cigsPerDay,
         age_glucose = age * glucose,
         sysBPsquared = sysBP * sysBP)


cardio_tree_interactions <- tree(TenYearCHD ~ age+ 
                                   sex + 
                                   is_smoking + 
                                   cigsPerDay + 
                                   BPMeds + 
                                   prevalentStroke + 
                                   prevalentHyp +
                                   diabetes +
                                   totChol+
                                   diaBP+
                                   sysBP+
                                   BMI+
                                   heartRate+
                                   glucose + 
                                   age_cigsPerDay +
                                   age_glucose + 
                                   sysBPsquared,
                                 data=data_interactions_poly)

plot(cardio_tree_interactions)
text(cardio_tree_interactions)

interaction_pred_train <- predict(cardio_tree_interactions, newdata=data_interactions_poly, type='class')

interaction_pred_test <- predict(cardio_tree_interactions, newdata = data_test_interactions_poly, type='class')

table(interaction_pred_train, data=data_interactions_poly$TenYearCHD)
table(interaction_pred_test, data=data_test_interactions_poly$TenYearCHD)
```

7) Final Model (Pruned Big Tree with Upsampled Data)

```{r}
cardio_rose_tree_big <- tree(TenYearCHD ~ age+ 
                               sex + 
                               is_smoking + 
                               cigsPerDay + 
                               BPMeds + 
                               prevalentStroke + 
                               prevalentHyp +
                               diabetes +
                               totChol+
                               diaBP+
                               sysBP+
                               BMI+
                               heartRate+
                               glucose,
                             data=cardio_rose_train,
                             control = tree.control(nrow(cardio_rose_train),
                                                    mindev=0.005))

plot(cardio_rose_tree_big)
text(cardio_rose_tree_big)

cardio_rose_tree_big_train <- predict(cardio_rose_tree_big, newdata=cardio_rose_train, type='class')
cardio_rose_tree_big_test  <- predict(cardio_rose_tree_big, newdata=cardio_rose_test, type='class')

table(cardio_rose_tree_big_train, cardio_rose_train$TenYearCHD)
table(cardio_rose_tree_big_test, cardio_rose_test$TenYearCHD)

rose_big_cv <- cv.tree(cardio_rose_tree_big, FUN = prune.misclass)


print(rose_big_cv)

cv.results <- data.frame(
  size = rose_big_cv$size,
  error = rose_big_cv$dev
)

print(cv.results)

pruned_cardio_rose_tree_big <- prune.misclass(cardio_rose_tree_big, best=9)

plot(pruned_cardio_rose_tree_big)
text(pruned_cardio_rose_tree_big)

pruned_cardio_rose_tree_big_train <- predict(pruned_cardio_rose_tree_big, newdata=cardio_rose_train, type='class')
pruned_cardio_rose_tree_big_test  <- predict(pruned_cardio_rose_tree_big, newdata=cardio_rose_test, type='class')

table(pruned_cardio_rose_tree_big_train, cardio_rose_train$TenYearCHD)
table(pruned_cardio_rose_tree_big_test, cardio_rose_test$TenYearCHD)


```

```{r}
pred_probs <- predict(pruned_cardio_rose_tree_big, newdata = cardio_rose_train)[, "1"]

true_TenYear <- cardio_rose_train$TenYearCHD
roc_obj <- roc(true_TenYear, pred_probs)

true_TenYear_test <- cardio_rose_test$TenYearCHD
roc_obj_test <- roc(true_TenYear_test, pred_probs_test)

auc(roc_obj_test)

plot(roc_obj, col="blue", main="ROC Curve", print.thres=c(0.01,0.03,0.1,0.5,0.8))
plot(roc_obj_test, col="blue", main="ROC Curve", print.thres=c(0.01,0.03,0.1,0.5,0.8))

ggplot(cardio_well_clean, aes(x = TenYearCHD, y = age, fill = TenYearCHD)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Age Distribution by 10-Year CHD Status",
       x = "10-Year CHD",
       y = "Age") +

```


# Outcome distribution
```{r}
  ggplot(cardio_well_clean,aes(x = factor(TenYearCHD))) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(title = "CHD Outcome Distribution", x = "TenYearCHD", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# BMI by CHD outcome
```{r}s
cardio_well_clean %>%
  group_by(TenYearCHD) %>%
  summarise(avg_BMI = mean(BMI, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(TenYearCHD), y = avg_BMI, fill = factor(TenYearCHD))) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(title = "Average BMI by CHD Outcome", x = "TenYearCHD", y = "Average BMI") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Smoking vs CHD
```{r}
cardio_well_clean %>%
  group_by(is_smoking, TenYearCHD) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = is_smoking, y = count, fill = TenYearCHD)) +
  geom_col(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(title = "Proportion of CHD by Smoking Status", y = "Proportion") +
  theme_minimal()
```

# Logistic regression model
```{r}
logit <- glm(TenYearCHD ~ BPMeds + prevalentStroke + prevalentHyp + diabetes + is_smoking,
             data = cardio_train, family = binomial)
summary(logit)

logit_prob <- predict(logit, newdata = cardio_test, type = "response")
logit_pred <- ifelse(logit_prob > 0.5, 1, 0)
```

# Confusion matrix
```{r}
cm <- confusionMatrix(as.factor(logit_pred), as.factor(cardio_test$TenYearCHD), positive = "1")
print(cm)
```

# ROC curve and AUC
```{r}
roc_logit <- roc(cardio_test$TenYearCHD, logit_prob)
plot(roc_logit, col = "blue", main = "ROC Curve - Logistic Regression")
auc_logit <- auc(roc_logit)
print(auc_logit)

metrics <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Accuracy", "Precision", "Recall (Sensitivity)", "Specificity", "AUC"),
  Value = c(
    cm$overall["Accuracy"],
    cm$byClass["Precision"],
    cm$byClass["Sensitivity"],
    cm$byClass["Specificity"],
    auc_logit
  )
)
print(metrics)
```
